Actions.Text: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION

Title: Relates to banning shock gloves
Summary: Prohibits any person, firm, corporation, association or agent or employee thereof from importing, manufacturing, selling, holding for sale or distributing shock gloves; makes possession of shock gloves a misdemeanor.
LawCode: Add §396-eeeee, Gen Bus L; amd §§265.00, 265.01 & 265.20, Pen L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law and the penal law, in relation to banning shock gloves
